decks.notes: The deck focuses on assembling the combo of equipping Colossus Hammer onto a creature, such as Ornithopter or Gingerbrute, for a lethal attack. It utilizes cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Puresteel Paladin to search for and equip the hammer efficiently. The deck also includes protection spells like Spell Pierce and Giver of Runes to ensure the combo goes off smoothly. Urza's Saga is used to find key artifacts like Colossus Hammer, while cards like Sigarda's Aid and Steelshaper's Gift help with equipment support. The goal is to quickly set up the combo and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful attack.

The deck focuses on aggressively utilizing Death's Shadow as a powerful threat, supported by cards like Kroxa and Dragon's Rage Channeler. The deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with spells and aggressively disrupt the opponent's game plan with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek. The deck also generates card advantage through cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration, while also having removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Terminate to deal with problematic creatures. The mana base is optimized for fetching lands efficiently to ensure consistent mana access.

This deck focuses on utilizing control elements to manage the board while also taking advantage of Elemental creatures to generate value and maintain board presence. The deck includes a variety of removal spells and interaction to control the game, along with creatures like Risen Reef and Omnath, Locus of Creation to generate card advantage and put pressure on the opponent. The addition of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion provides additional value by blinking permanents for extra triggers and staying ahead in the game.

The deck focuses on quick and aggressive plays, utilizing cheap and efficient instants and sorceries to control the board while dealing damage to the opponent. Cards like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat provide removal, while Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help with card advantage. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent are the main threats, putting pressure on the opponent early in the game. The deck also includes some counterspells and card draw to maintain its tempo and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, the deck aims to win the game by overwhelming the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle.

This deck focuses on control through a mix of removal spells, countermagic, and powerful creatures to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The key strategy is to utilize cards like Solitude, Counterspell, and Teferi, Time Raveler to control the board while generating value with cards like Wrenn and Six and Ice-Fang Coatl. The deck also utilizes Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion to provide additional value through flickering creatures and permanents. The mana base is carefully crafted to ensure consistent access to all colors of mana needed to cast the powerful spells in the deck.

The main strategy of this deck is to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. The deck also aims to generate value through cards like Wrenn and Six and Teferi, Time Raveler, while utilizing strong mana fixing and ramp with cards like Abundant Growth and Omnath, Locus of Creation. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional synergy and value through its ability to flicker permanents for extra value.

The deck focuses on creating a toolbox of creatures that can be searched for and played in order to execute a powerful combo strategy. The key idea is to use cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, Chord of Calling, and Eldritch Evolution to tutor for specific creatures like Endurance, Blood Artist, and Geralf's Messenger to create strong board presence and win conditions. The mana base is designed to support this strategy and provide consistency in casting the necessary creatures and spells.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Terminate to clear the way for early threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer. Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek help disrupt the opponent's game plan, while Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide recurring value and pressure. The deck aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent while disrupting their strategy, ultimately aiming to overpower them with a combination of burn spells and powerful creatures.

This deck focuses on generating value through powerful control cards and card advantage engines. The key strategy involves utilizing removal spells, counterspells, and efficient creatures to control the game while drawing cards and ramping with cards like Expressive Iteration and Wrenn and Six. Yorion, Sky Nomad provides additional value by flickering permanents for extra card advantage. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent by generating incremental advantages and maintaining control over the board, ultimately grinding out a win through attrition.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana through cards like Arboreal Grazer and Azusa, Lost but Seeking, and utilizing Primeval Titan to search for key lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Vesuva. The combo potential lies in using Amulet of Vigor to untap lands and generate extra mana, allowing for explosive plays. The deck utilizes Urza's Saga to fetch utility lands and control the board with cards like Summoner's Pact. The goal is to quickly assemble the necessary pieces to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and land-based interactions.

The deck focuses on utilizing Amulet of Vigor to ramp into big threats like Primeval Titan, with the help of cards like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove and Azusa, Lost but Seeking. The goal is to quickly assemble the Amulet Titan combo, allowing for explosive turns and powerful board presence to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes utility lands like Urza's Saga and Cavern of Souls to further support the combo and protect against disruption, while maintaining consistency through cards like Summoner's Pact and Exploration.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly combo off by using Glimpse of Tomorrow to exile a large portion of your library and put all nonland permanents into play. This allows you to overwhelm your opponent with powerful creatures and triggers from cards like Risen Reef and Omnath, Locus of Creation. The deck also utilizes cards like Shardless Agent and Wavesifter to generate card advantage and consistently find key pieces of the combo. Fury and Endurance provide protection and disruption to help you maintain control of the game until you can execute your game-winning combo.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Colossus Hammer with Puresteel Paladin or Stoneforge Mystic to create a powerful and lethal threat. The key strategy is to use cheap artifacts like Memnite and Ornithopter to quickly equip the hammer and swing for a massive amount of damage, often winning the game in a single turn. The deck also includes disruption cards like Spell Pierce and Esper Sentinel to protect the combo and disrupt opponents' plans. Urza's Saga provides additional consistency and tutoring for key pieces of the combo.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo using cards like Colossus Hammer, Stoneforge Mystic, and Puresteel Paladin to equip powerful artifacts like Kaldra Compleat onto small, evasive creatures. The deck also includes cards like Esper Sentinel and Giver of Runes to disrupt opponents and protect its key pieces. Urza's Saga is used to tutor for key artifacts, while cards like Spell Pierce and Blacksmith's Skill offer additional utility and protection. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm opponents with a big, fast attack.

This deck focuses on assembling the powerful combo of Heliod, Sun-Crowned and Spike Feeder to create an infinite life gain loop. The deck includes cards like Auriok Champion and Ranger-Captain of Eos to protect and tutor for combo pieces, while utilizing Collected Company to dig for key cards. The presence of cards like Teferi, Time Raveler also helps to disrupt opponents' strategies and ensure the combo can be executed smoothly. With the right setup, this deck can quickly gain infinite life and overwhelm opponents with its resilient combo.

This deck focuses on utilizing efficient spells and creatures to apply early pressure on the opponent while also maintaining control through counterspells and permission spells. The deck aims to quickly deploy threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Archmage's Charm and Counterspell. By combining aggression with disruption, the deck aims to outpace the opponent and secure a victory before they can stabilize or mount a defense. The mana base is designed to support the deck's spells and provide consistent access to all of its colors.
